mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which supports corporate hiring and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a positive month-over-month PAYEMS change.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both INDPRO and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) signals a manufacturing contraction, which reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with a positive month-over-month HOUST change.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a dual shock of monetary tightening and economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds from both policy and demand.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) indicates a weak labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days by keeping discount rates low and boosting risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.
